diffusionModel.description: Qwen-Image-Edit transformer, loaded by ComfyUI's UNETLoader.

textEncoder.description: Qwen2.5-VL text encoder, loaded by CLIPLoader with type qwen_image.

outputDir.description: Root that every job output path is confined to.

inputDir.description: Root that a job's reference images are confined to. ComfyUI is given this as its own input directory, so a reference is named relative to it and nothing outside it can be read.

scratchDir.description: Where ComfyUI keeps its own output, temp, user and database files. Nothing here is the library's; finished images are moved out of it.

weightDtype.description: How the transformer is held. The bf16 checkpoint is 19 GiB against a 16 GiB card, so fp8 is what keeps it resident instead of streamed; fp8_e4m3fn_fast additionally uses the card's fp8 matmul.

textEncoderDevice.description: cpu keeps Qwen2.5-VL off the card entirely, which frees room for the transformer at the cost of a slower prompt encode.

vramMode.description: dynamic is ComfyUI's own memory manager, which streams whatever will not fit. The rest pin its behaviour.

attention.description: Attention backend. sage and flash need their own packages installed into this arm's venv.

reserveVram.description: GiB left to the desktop compositor. Too little and Windows starts evicting the model behind ComfyUI's back.

cacheMode.description: What ComfyUI keeps between jobs. ram is its default; none re-runs every node each time, which throws away the cached prompt encode a batch depends on.

extraArgs.description: Extra ComfyUI command line flags, split on whitespace and passed through verbatim.
